title: CONTRACT FOR DESIGN, MANUFACTURE AND ASSEMBLY OF A 2.5 M TELESCOPE AND A BUILDING-DOME AT THE MONTSEC OBSERVATORY
description:
The purpose of this contract is:
a.- Design, manufacturing, supply and installation services of a 2.5 m aperture telescope.
